in_sanskrit.name: Athant
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brahmin, Pure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Athant एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Athant is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a name of reverence, denoting purity and a connection to the Brahmin caste. The name carries a deep spiritual significance and is often given to boys in Hindu communities.
